calendar.noDateHint: Long press a task, then drag it onto the calendar
calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.intro: Connect a calendar to see its events in Today and Upcoming. Each account can connect one calendar.
calendar.opening: Opening the browser to grant access. When you are done you will be brought back to Taskly.
calendar.showEventsHint: Read-only events, shown in Today and Upcoming.
calendar.syncTasksHint: Your tasks with a date are added to a separate "Taskly" calendar. Moving an event in that calendar updates the task if it does not repeat; repeating tasks only change in Taskly.
calendar.syncResult: Synced: {{created}} added, {{updated}} updated, {{deleted}} removed, {{pulled}} changed from the calendar
calendar.needsReauth: Access to the calendar was revoked. Disconnect and connect again.
calendar.disconnectMessage: Taskly stops showing events and stops syncing. The "Taskly" calendar already created in your calendar account is kept.

feed.title: Calendar feed
feed.description: A read-only iCal link to subscribe to in Google Calendar, Outlook or Apple Calendar. Repeating tasks show at most 7 times. Anyone with the link can see your calendar.
feed.resetMessage: The old link stops working right away. Calendars subscribed with the old link need to subscribe again with the new one.
feed.resetDone: New link created and copied to the clipboard

errors.alreadyConnected: A calendar is already connected. Disconnect it before connecting another one.
errors.notConfigured: The server is not set up to connect this calendar.
errors.unavailable: Could not reach the calendar service, please try again later.
errors.openFailed: Could not open the browser to connect the calendar.
errors.denied: Access to the calendar was not granted, so it could not be connected.
errors.invalidState: The connection request has expired. Please try again.
errors.connectFailed: Could not connect the calendar, please try again.
